entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it?
It's not working. The pulse tracker is completely unreliable and it won't sync with my phone anymore. It's defective.
I understand your frustration. It sounds like you'd just prefer to return it at this point. Let me pull up your account with your phone number... one moment.
Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 22 days ago. Let me just double-check our return policy for you.

Alright, I've checked our knowledge base, and it states all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that period, so I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.
Oh. I figured you'd make it difficult. Whatever, that's fine.

Not at all. I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just place the defective band back in its original packaging and use that label to send it back to us.
And I'll get my money back?
Yes, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method as soon as our warehouse receives the item. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
